description: Replay engine rp-5 and its runs: route every git call through gitio (fix the un-allowlisted add -N / diff in replay._run_git_env), delete the dead `if False` branch, keep _PIN_FALLBACK as a warned fallback, cache and reuse gold-first records (so a cached --replay re-runs nothing), classify platform-skipped required nodes as INFRA with the JUnit skip reasons, add --required-nodes added|hunk (default added = rp-4 judging unchanged; hunk only ADDS enclosing test functions of modified test_patch hunks), write base-env pip-freeze evidence artifacts, add the `replay` and `gold-gate` subcommands (the recipe and agent already call `B replay`), replay scope tiers, gold_coverage.json + KB_SUMMARY §13a/§13b; then run gold-first for all 48 rich tasks (+ bounded fastapi) and replay the new rows' candidates gold-first until replays_pending=0 or a reported stop. Depends on FEAT-001 (rows) and FEAT-003 (build pipeline complete). Plan items 15-20 (decisions D5-19..D5-23).
steps: Item 15: kblib\gitio.git gains extra_env=None (merged into the env) and binary=False (return bytes stdout); in kblib\replay.py replace both _run_git_env calls in _candidate_diff with gitio.git(wt, 'add', '-N', '.', scope='worktree', eol=True, odb=self.odb, alt=clone/'.git'/'objects', extra_env=env_excl) and gitio.git(wt, 'diff', '--binary', ..., binary=True, extra_env=env_excl); delete _run_git_env and the dead `... if False else None` statement; the _PIN_FALLBACK branch appends 'PIN-FALLBACK <task> <pkg>==<ver>' to a module-level warnings list that build_kb.py writes (sorted) into build_log.txt; set RP_VERSION='rp-5'. The allowlist sets must stay exactly as they are (test_gitio_allowlist_exact_set unchanged). New static test: replay.py source contains no 'if False' and no subprocess.run call with a 'git' argv outside gitio.

Item 16: (a) gold-first cache: replays\gold\<task>.json gains key fields {engine_version, pins, required_mode, task_fingerprint, env.python, env.pytest}; build_kb._run_replays and the new subcommands reuse a matching record instead of re-running gold/base; (b) _parse_junit records skipped_names and skip_reasons (the <skipped message=...> text); gold_first: if gold exit 0, failed 0, errors 0 and every missing required node is in skipped_names -> gold_first 'INFRA', reason 'required nodes skipped on this platform: <unique skip messages>'; (c) required_mode threaded through run_candidate -> _required_tests(gt, wt, mode): 'added' = sorted(set(added_tests)) exactly as rp-4; 'hunk' = added ∪ the enclosing def test_* names (and Class::method) of every modified hunk of test_patch, computed from kblib\unidiff hunk new-side ranges + ast.parse of the post-test_patch file in the worktree; cache key includes required_mode; (d) env freeze: ReplayEngine.__enter__ writes replays\env_freeze_before.txt (python -m pip freeze --all, sorted, via io.safe_write), __exit__ writes env_freeze_after.txt and env_freeze_check.json {identical, n_before, n_after, python}; not identical -> raise -> CLI exit 4. Never install into the base env; pins stay in isolated --target dirs.

Item 17: build_kb.py cmd_replay (design §15.1: --task T plus one of --run R | --candidate PATH | --gold; --kind as_run|final|counterfactual|intent; --force; --required-nodes added|hunk; --deadline-s; --lock-wait-s; takes the build lock; gold/base controls first if no cached record; prints one result line per candidate; rewrites replays.jsonl from cache) and cmd_gold_gate (--repo rich|fastapi, --tasks ..., --deadline-s, --required-nodes; resumable through the gold cache; CloneGuard snapshot/verify around it; one line per task). `build --replay-scope min|rich|all` (default rich): tier 0 curated min_set + all_runs rules; tier 1 Kaggle main-track rows with a trace; tier 2 Kaggle other tracks; tier 3 local-rig rows; sweep rows never; 'all' adds fastapi rows; within a tier sort by run_id; candidates only for tasks whose gold_first is VALID-*; others recorded without running.

Item 18: new kblib\goldcov.py: gold_coverage.json (one row per rich task (48) + each fastapi task attempted: rp-5 verdict, reason, pins, pin_provenance, gold_pass_n, required_mode results, concordance with replays\goldgate_all.json and audits\_decode_sweep_cache\gold_gate.json = agree|disagree|absent) and KB_SUMMARY §13a; §13b lists every task whose added_tests is empty (whole-file fallback), its test files, and the count of test functions in modified hunks (static from tasks.jsonl test_patch), plus hunk-mode verdicts where run. Read goldgate_all.json / gold_gate.json read-only; never count them as rp-5 gold records.

Unit tests (tests\test_unit.py): junit with a skipped required node -> INFRA with the skip message; 'hunk' mode on a synthetic test_patch modifying the body of test_b adds test_b and never drops an added node; 'added' mode returns exactly the rp-4 list; parser accepts the replay/gold-gate options; tier ordering on synthetic rows; --replay-scope min = min set only; gitio extra_env/binary. Keep _selftest_pins.py passing.

Item 19 (long, background, resumable): `python c:\Users\Biges\OneDrive\Documents\Desktop\kAGGLE\Gemma\kb\build_kb.py gold-gate --repo rich --deadline-s 1750 *> $env:TEMP\kb_gg.txt` as a background process, poll, relaunch until all 48 rich tasks have rp-5 records (~50 min measured for rp-4); then gold-gate --repo rich --tasks <the rich tasks on the whole-file fallback, from §13b> --required-nodes hunk; then gold-gate --repo fastapi --deadline-s 1800 once (unfinished tasks reported 'not run (deadline)'). Expect rich_3468/3486/3675/3782 -> INFRA with Windows skip messages (log 2026-10-16 'ITEM 1 CLOSED'); if any differs, report it as measured.

Item 20 (long, background, resumable): `build --replay --deadline-s 1700 --lock-wait-s 120 *> $env:TEMP\kb_br.txt` repeatedly until replays_pending=0, or stop and report the pending count + tiers left; then one more cached `build --replay` must show replays_run_this_build=0 and no gold control run; then two plain builds + idempotence compare. Write `git -C c:\Users\Biges\OneDrive\Documents\Desktop\kAGGLE\Gemma\local_eval\repos\rich status --porcelain` and the fastapi equivalent to c:\Users\Biges\OneDrive\Documents\Desktop\kAGGLE\Gemma\kb\replays\clone_status_final.txt (via a small io.safe_write helper or the build). Never touch repos\_wt_capconv_ctrl_A3_r0_rich_3772.

Record in findings: per-task gold-first table summary (counts by verdict, the 4 INFRA reasons, any disagreement with goldgate_all.json), hunk-mode results, fastapi coverage, replays run / pending, cached rerun result, env_freeze_check, clone status, total wall time.

findings:
CODE (rp-5): kblib/gitio.git(+extra_env,+binary; allowlist sets unchanged); kblib/replay.py RP_VERSION rp-5, _run_git_env + dead `if False` deleted, _candidate_diff = 2 gitio calls (add -N ., diff --binary) with core.excludesFile via GIT_CONFIG_* extra_env; module WARNINGS list ('PIN-FALLBACK <task> <pkg>==<ver>', written sorted/unique to build_log.txt as 'WARNING ...'); pins_at_commit() (reads <base>:poetry.lock via main-ro cat-file, gold-cache key); gold cache read_gold/write_gold/gold_key (replays/gold/<task>.json for 'added', replays/gold/hunk/<task>.json for 'hunk'; key = engine_version, pins, required_mode, task_fingerprint, env.python/pytest); _parse_junit skipped_names + skip_reasons; _missing_required; _required_tests(gt, wt, mode, test_patch) + hunk_test_nodes() (unidiff now records per-hunk added_new_lines / removed_at_new); candidate cache dir <sha12> for added, <sha12>-hunk otherwise, required_mode in key; ReplayEngine(freeze=True) writes replays/env_freeze_before.txt / env_freeze_after.txt / env_freeze_check.json, raises EnvFreezeError -> CLI exit 4. New kblib/goldcov.py (gold_coverage.json + KB_SUMMARY §13a/§13b). build_kb.py: cmd_replay, cmd_gold_gate, replay_targets() tiers (0 min_set+all_runs; 1 Kaggle main; 2 Kaggle other tracks; 3 local-rig; sweeps never; scope min|rich|all; row needs >=1 edit attempt or patch_chars>0, design §13.6), _gold_cached_or_run (reuses key-matching gold), recon index replays/recon_index.json ((run,task,kind) -> candidate sha keyed on trace size+mtime+FC version) so a cached --replay does not re-parse traces, non-VALID gold -> record UNVERIFIED without running, build_stamp gains gold_controls_run_this_build/tiers_left/replay_scope/required_nodes/targets/env_freeze_check, replays/clone_status_final.txt writer, gold records + decode-sweep gold_gate.json added to the input fingerprint, replays/gold_coverage.json added to generated_files, replay table in KB_SUMMARY summarized (counts by tier/kind/result + capped detail rows). Fixed a pre-existing bug: plain builds counted cached records as replays_run_this_build (was 14 on a plain build). DEVIATION beyond the plan (stated): gold whose collection / package import fails on a module missing from the base env is INFRA ('test dependency missing in the base env: missing <mod>' / 'package under test failed to import in the base env: missing <mod>') instead of INVALID; both are excluded from counted replays, so no bar changes. --kind final|intent are accepted by the parser but return exit 1 NOT_IMPLEMENTED (rp-5 reconstructs as_run + counterfactual only). Hunk-mode required names are bare function names (JUnit testcase names are bare); Class::method form is kept in hunk_nodes for the record.
